class Nested extends PureComponent {
    componentWillUpdate() {
        on(function() { this.setState({}); });
        on(() => this.setState({}));
        function helper() { this.setState({}); }
        const object = {
            method() { this.setState({}); },
            get value() { this.setState({}); return 1; },
            set value(next) { this.setState({}); }
        };
        class Inner { method() { this.setState({}); } }
    }
}
